title: Natural hypercover cohomology and its colimit universal property
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and $U$ a finite split etale hypercover of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover]. Let $A$ be an abelian category (in particular abelian groups or modules over a fixed ring), and $q\in\mathbb N$. Define the functor $K_U^q:\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{Et}},A)\to A$ by taking degree-$q$ homology of the alternating coface complex of $F(U_\bullet)$. A refinement $f:U\to V$ induces a natural transformation $f^*:K_V^q\to K_U^q$ by restriction. A functor $H:\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{Et}},A)\to A$ is the natural hypercover cohomology colimit in degree $q$ if homotopic refinements have equal induced transformations and there are natural transformations $c_U:K_U^q\to H$ with $f^*c_U=c_V$ for every refinement, such that for every sheaf $F$, every $B\in A$ and every compatible family $d_U:K_U^q(F)\to B$, there is a unique $e:H(F)\to B$ satisfying $c_U(F)e=d_U$ for all $U$. This is the pointwise colimit over refinements modulo simplicial homotopy, naturally in $F$.
